context: Little momentum on 25 Sep -- BankNIFTY roamed around 55500 -- so buyers and sellers both came, but the afternoon breakout drove the SELLERS out, and it is trying to go down again.
plan: THE BRANCHES FLIPPED AGAIN FROM 25 SEP: on Friday flat to gap-down meant BUY and a gap up meant SELL. Tonight flat to gap-down means SELL and a gap up with momentum means BUY. Carrying Friday's branches forward inverts both.

FLAT TO GAP DOWN -> SELL, WITH THE MARKET: the breakout already drove the sellers out, so there is no seated seller to hunt upward; identify selling-side setups as it tries to go down again. A follow, not a hunt.
GAP UP WITH POSITIVE MOMENTUM FROM THE OPEN -> BUY: the market may trap sellers who try to sell the gap, then rise slowly and go much higher; identify buying-side setups.
A GAP UP THAT STARTS FALLING HAS NO PLAN: he says no plan can be made then. A computed GAP_UP verdict alone does not select the buy branch; the momentum after the open decides.
